d.ko: 인크레디박스는 몇 번의 클릭만으로 비트박스 그룹을 만들 수 있는 리듬게임입니다.
d.en: Incredibox is a music game that lets you create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers.
d.zh: Incredibox是一款让你在简单几步操作之下就能够成为beatbox嘻哈大师的混音模拟器。

rv.t: 이 게임은 감성과 성의 모두를 보여줬습니다 😎
If your kids are gonna play a game, this is the game they should play, and you should play it with them and then everyone should dance.
I put the game on auto mode before I took a poop, then came back to the most heavenly orchestrated mix in history. 11/10 would poop again.
Incredibly simplistic, I thought you would at least be able to change the pitch or mix songs. No. You cannot even mix the samples from different songs together creating something unique. …
现在的首要目的是来一个快捷键一个个手拖太麻烦了
其实我希望能加一个音轨条时间轴，我玩不下去的原因就是没法系统规划作品，全凭个人律动、乐感
